<section class="s-intro" aria-label="Introduction">
  <div>
    <p class="s-intro__name" role="heading" aria-level="1">Nichodemus Amollo</p>
    <p class="s-intro__role">Statistician and epidemiologist · Nairobi, Kenya</p>
    <p class="s-lede">I build the research data systems that health and development programmes depend on, and I study how health financing shapes chronic care in Kenya.</p>
    <p>I am a Data Analyst at <a href="https://gui2de.georgetown.edu/profiles/nichodemus-amollo/">Georgetown University's gui²de</a> in East Africa. My research looks at insurance coverage, facility financing and treatment gaps for people living with hypertension, diabetes and disability, with a focus on Kenya's move from NHIF to the Social Health Authority.</p>
    <p>I also founded <a href="https://www.gpakgirls.org/team">GPAK Girls</a>, a Homa Bay organisation that supports adolescent mothers and pregnant girls in western Kenya.</p>
